candidates.title: Memory May Revise Interpretation, Not Evidence
candidates.title_zh: 记忆可以改写解释，不能改写证据
candidates.researchQuestion: 当长寿命智能体持续更新记忆时，哪些状态应保持不可变，哪些状态可以重新解释，又必须保留什么恢复证据，才能避免错误语义判断悄悄改写未来决策所依赖的证据历史？
candidates.coreProposition: Long-lived memory should make evidence harder to mutate than interpretation by separating immutable observations, relation decisions, active retrieval views, and recoverable evidence history.

sections.heading: What Non-Destructive Storage Protects
sections.heading_zh: 非破坏式存储保护了什么

sections.heading: Deterministic Transition Is Not Semantic Truth
sections.heading_zh: 确定性迁移不等于语义正确

sections.heading: A Stored Record Can Lose Influence
sections.heading_zh: 记录还在，也可能失去影响

sections.heading: Four Identities Make Error Recoverable
sections.heading_zh: 四个身份让错误可以恢复

sections.heading: Remembered Approval Is Not Current Authority
sections.heading_zh: 记住批准，不等于当前获准

evidenceClaims.claim: ROAM preserves incoming observations as immutable atomic records while later semantic relations alter roles rather than source text.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，该方法将新观察保存为不可变原子记录，后续语义关系只改变角色而不改写来源文本。

evidenceClaims.claim: A deterministic precedence rule governs state transition after a model-mediated relation label is produced.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，在模型产生关系标签后，固定优先规则负责确定性状态迁移。

evidenceClaims.claim: Primary and fused retrieval views change answer-time influence while underlying atomic records remain preserved.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，主要视图和融合视图会改变回答时的影响力，而底层原子记录仍被保留。

evidenceClaims.claim: Reported benchmark and ablation results support relation-aware management, non-destructive organization, and retrieval choices under tested memory workloads.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，基准与消融结果在测试的记忆任务中支持关系管理、非破坏式组织和检索选择。

evidenceClaims.claim: Observation, relation decision, active view, and evidence history require separate identities so semantic errors remain reversible.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，观察、关系决定、当前视图和证据历史应拥有不同身份，使语义错误可以撤销。

candidates.title: Deterministic Coordination Starts Where Semantics Become Observable
candidates.title_zh: 语义可观察，确定性协调才成立
candidates.researchQuestion: 当复合智能体系统用确定性机制替代生成式协调管理器时，什么证据足以证明局部可复现的单元选择可以承担全局业务含义？
candidates.coreProposition: Deterministic coordination may carry business meaning only when unit identity, candidate admissibility, and relevant coupling constraints are sufficiently observable; reproducibility and provenance do not settle hidden semantics.

sections.heading: Deterministic Selection Requires a Representation Contract
sections.heading_zh: 确定性选择先依赖表示合同

sections.heading: Residual Work Needs an Identity
sections.heading_zh: 剩余工作必须拥有身份

sections.heading: Coupling Determines Whether Local Results Compose
sections.heading_zh: 耦合决定局部结果能否组合

sections.heading: When Intelligent Management Must Remain
sections.heading_zh: 何时必须保留智能管理

evidenceClaims.claim: UnitBoost represents target output as identifiable units, selects admissible candidate values deterministically, records unit provenance, and materializes residual work.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，该方法把目标输出表示为可识别单元，确定性选择合格候选，记录单元出处并物化剩余工作。

evidenceClaims.claim: Under stated assumptions, the selection operator is order-invariant.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，在声明假设成立时，选择算子不受候选顺序影响。

evidenceClaims.claim: Reported held-out comparisons show gains over strongest single candidates and tested generative managers across multiple configurations.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，多组留出比较中，单元级协调超过最强单一候选及被测试的生成式管理器。

evidenceClaims.claim: True residual targeting outperforms random targeting and rereading controls in the reported experiments.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，针对真实剩余单元的后续处理优于随机目标和重新阅读对照。

evidenceClaims.claim: Deterministic coordination can own only decisions whose unit identities, admissibility inputs, and coupling constraints are sufficiently observable.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，确定性协调只能负责单元身份、准入输入和耦合约束足够可观察的决定。
